answer: In PoA, each agent identity is validated by a Wesolowski VDF whose proof commits to a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings. Because every square depends on the preceding result, an attacker simulating multiple clones cannot parallelize each computation across GPUs; fabricating identities multiplies elapsed wall-clock time rather than throughput. A juniper node, ripple of forged identities, or hidden vault of keys gains no shortcut: physical delay remains the Sybil barrier.
